remaining_open_items: ESL and part-specific ripple current/dVdt remain unresolved.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-10, D059): The generic 10 mm default remains unbound to an exact rated part. Resolution: WIMA MKS4G031003F (MKS 4, 0.1 uF, 400 VDC/200 VAC) is the only 0.1 uF row in the archived WIMA 2026 catalogue with the OHMNI default body (PCM 10, 13 x 5 x 11 mm); it is a general DC PET series, not a safety part. The 400 VDC grade is chosen by that body match; its rating replaces the spec's assumed 100 V peak.
ESR/ESL, ripple current and pulse dV/dt are not bound (the p40 pulse table's row order looks misprinted, so dV/dt is not used).
